description:
Verification and hosted-write item (D7, D8). After the site and core reporter, fetch, parent-lookup, snapshot and probe items have merged, show with run evidence that the pipeline works and close the stale incident.
Steps (each gate snapshot once per invocation, G10): (1) list recent core site-inputs runs on develop and site deploy runs (the batch's own merges produce them); identify at least one core bundle build and one site deploy that ran with the merged fixes and succeeded; (2) confirm the open site-bundle-failed / site-bundle-undeployed issues received no new comment for a failure of a class the fixes address after the merge SHAs; (3) confirm a successful run closed any relay issue it should have (live check of the new close path); (4) comment on #2979 with the evidence (merge SHAs, run URLs, the six-cause table: 25 parent lookup, 4 snapshot digest, 3 contract version, 1 egress 503, 3 probe mismatch, 1 producer race) and close it ONLY if the latest site deploy and core bundle runs are green and no unresolved cause remains.
If a cause remains unresolved (for example the probe-mismatch diagnosis found platform behavior it could not fix), comment with the evidence, leave #2979 open, and create a follow-up item.
